docs.thesis:
Other AIs teach you knowledge.
We train the very act of teaching you.
docs.thesisSub: Generic AI assistants serve everyone with the same assembly line. Lemma builds an evolving cognitive model for every learner — every interaction updates it, every teaching decision optimizes against it.
docs.hook1Desc: An evolving cognitive profile for every user: what you know, what you don't, where you're stuck, and how you learn best.
docs.hook2Desc: The system learns how to teach you: teaching strategies are trained by their own results. No generic assistant can copy this moat.
docs.hook3Desc: The AI pauses first: it probes your understanding before answering. No cramming, no shortcuts — accountable only for real learning.
docs.diff1After: Knowledge state = probability (BKT / IRT cognitive modeling)
docs.diff3After: Expected learning rate maximization — pick the concept that advances you most
docs.diff4After: Teaching strategies trained by results (self-evolving teaching)
docs.diff5After: WAM collaboration protocol: cross-session continuity + weight judgment + evidence verification
docs.pill1Desc: Hermes learner five layers: identity / knowledge / patterns / episodes / meta_rules — 7 cognitive tables.
docs.pill2Desc: An onboarding more tempting than character creation: mold a teacher who knows you (name / personality / method / temperament / edit SOUL.md directly), or pick a template.
docs.pill3Desc: TOEFL / AP / competitions are just the engine's presentation layer: same cognitive engine, different exam paper. Scores are process metrics; deep understanding is the endgame.
docs.pill4Desc: “Wait a Minute”: AI stays in sync with you, advances in directional 1% steps, verifies every move with evidence. Anti-utilitarianism, engineered.
docs.moatDesc:
The more you learn → the better the model knows you → the better it teaches → the more you learn.
Learner data is the fuel, teaching self-evolution is the engine, the learning genome is the asset.
docs.m0: Engine foundation (Hermes learner merged, cognitive modeling integration)
docs.m1: Companion loop (persona injection, Agent Forge v1, Learn Space container)
docs.m2: Adaptive teaching (WAM six-step loop, expected learning rate, LemmaX TOEFL)
docs.m3: Proactive intelligence (review scheduling, learning reports, competition exams)
docs.quote:
Today's AI learning products are like a book in a bookstore — you open it, you keep going alone.
Lemma is the teacher beside you: one who knows you, follows you, pushes you, until you truly learn.
